glosses: of a concept or thing, known

examples.en: I wish I had known the truth.

examples.text: Tom não teria sabido a diferença.
examples.en: Tom wouldn't have known the difference.

examples.text: Quem me dera ter sabido que isso ia acontecer.
examples.en: I wish I'd known that was going to happen.

examples.text: Se eu tivesse sabido, ter-to-ia dito.
examples.en: If I'd known it, I'd have told you.

examples.text: É uma vergonha Tom não ter sabido.
examples.en: It's a shame Tom didn't know.
